shortlist.label: Mobitz Type II Atrioventricular Block
shortlist.why_kept: Prolonged PR interval and some P waves do not conduct to ventricles

shortlist.label: Sick Sinus Syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Abnormal heart rhythm and conduction, patient is in their 70s

shortlist.label: Complete Heart Block
shortlist.why_kept: Prolonged His-ventricular interval and abnormal heart rhythm

shortlist.label: His-Purkinje Disease
shortlist.why_kept: Prolonged His-ventricular interval and right bundle-branch block

shortlist.label: Lev-Lenegre Disease
shortlist.why_kept: Prolonged PR interval and right bundle-branch block, age of patient

raw.rationale: The patient's ECG findings show a normal sinus rhythm with a prolonged PR interval and some P waves that do not conduct to ventricles, which is consistent with Mobitz Type II Atrioventricular Block. The electrophysiology study also shows a prolonged His-ventricular interval, further supporting this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Sick Sinus Syndrome
rejected.why: The patient's ECG shows a normal sinus rhythm, which is not consistent with Sick Sinus Syndrome.

rejected.label: Complete Heart Block
rejected.why: The patient's ECG shows that some P waves do conduct to ventricles, which is not consistent with Complete Heart Block.

rejected.label: His-Purkinje Disease
rejected.why: While the patient's ECG shows a prolonged His-ventricular interval, this finding alone is not sufficient to diagnose His-Purkinje Disease without further evidence of disease in the His-Purkinje system.

rejected.label: Lev-Lenegre Disease
rejected.why: The patient's age and ECG findings are not typical of Lev-Lenegre Disease, which is a rare condition that typically presents with a prolonged PR interval and widening of the QRS complex in younger patients.

gold: Infrahisian Mobitz type I second-degree AV block (Wenckebach phenomenon occurring in His-Purkinje system)
